summary: Every O2 supplies service ticket carries the non-billable supplies tag on the Ticket tab (also step 5 of 7.2.2).
Oxygen tanks are not delivered to a medical facility for general stock — a request not tied to a named patient — except rarely, with the Field Operations Supervisor.
Oxygen is provided only within 50 miles of the Dallas (Irving) or San Antonio warehouses.
Escalation chain: call and text the on-call, then call and text again, then Level 1, then Level 2 — 30 minutes each. A dispatch is not acknowledged until the technician or RT confirms it.
An after-hours service ticket sets Service Type to After Hours on the Ticket tab.
On-call technicians and RTs call the patient first and troubleshoot by phone, confirm a dispatch to the on-call phone, and message it again once the issue is resolved.
A patient calling back about a scheduling message: never confirm the date yourself — transfer to Field Ops so they schedule against current availability.
Before an SOS-affecting pick-up, tell the patient they will likely struggle to get similar equipment through insurance for five years. Patient-owned equipment is never picked up, even on request.
Hospital bed relocation: a Field Ops or Service supervisor approves, and the call routes to Service.

A package the carrier shows as delivered that the patient never received goes to Service, which opens a lost-package claim with FedEx — no police report. Insurance-rep complaints about a service refusal go to the Service Supervisor.
A diagnostic visit is charged when the patient refuses the requested photos or video, or a technician recently found the equipment working and it is again fully functional.
provenance: Operator manual update 2026-10-06 (list line 242; decision 17 — the $75 stands until confirmed)

summary: Competitor PMD referrals removed. A patient we can't service is pointed to a local DME repair service, which must be enrolled with or in network for the plan for insurance to pay.

PAR responses: email Power with "PAR Response Received:"; requests for more information go to the Authorization (PAR) team, subject "PAR Additional Info Requested:". Some PARs are a dual submission to traditional Medicare and the MA plan.
A PMD can be delivered to a nursing home that is the patient's permanent residence — never a hospital, rehab facility or SNF.
Standard vs complex rehab power wheelchairs, by Medicare group; complex rehab needs a specialty evaluation and an ATP, and can be billed as a purchase.
A brand-new lead: name and DOB, then the phone number; with no record, transfer to the Sales Q.
A walker on an insurance order isn't shipped out of state; an out-of-pocket order lifts the state limit, but never a delivery radius.
No cutoff for a wheelchair size change: before delivery the Manual Mobility team acts on it; after delivery, Service or a pick-up-ticket swap.
A same-items resupply goes to the Resupply team on the email tool's Repeat Resupply form, subject "[Category] [Month] Resupply: [Patient name], DOB: [date]".
Ventilator issue: Service Q first; if no answer, email respiratory@ and service@ and notify an RT.

Compliance has a grace period of about one month after a lapse; persistent non-compliance — more than a month past it, after several notices — may lead to a pick-up. Compliance is noted with an end date.
Respiratory machine pick-ups: create the ticket; Field Ops reviews every pick-up ticket and decides whether more is needed. No discontinue prescription is needed to create it.
Outbound calls: open "on a recorded line", make at least two attempts using another caller ID, and leave no patient details on a voicemail.
A diagnostic visit is charged when the patient hasn't sent photos or video of the equipment and the issue, or a recent service visit found no issue.
provenance: Operator manual update 2026-10-06 (list line 40); the fee amount is with Service to confirm

summary: Never transfer directly to a Spanish-speaking agent to get around the Spanish Queue or inbox — a direct transfer isn't queued or tracked.
A complaint record has five fields; the health insurance claim number is no longer collected.
POVs are ineligible for ROHO cushions.
